why: reads a params file off disk. `rcl_yaml_param_parser` exists to parse a `--params-file` off a FILESYSTEM at node start and hand rcl a tree of overrides. A device image has no filesystem and no YAML parser; parameter defaults are baked into the image at build time (RFC-0045) and changed afterwards over `~/set_parameters`. What a user loses is `--params-file` and everything that reads one.
